input:
You are queen_d1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 41. the team planned Qe3+ (queen_d1), but queen_d1 (amnesia) sent Qh5+ instead, and that move was played, costing 346 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 27. the team planned Be4 (bishop_f1), but pawn_b2 (greed) sent axb5 instead, and that move was played, costing 10 centipawns.
- On move 39. the team planned Bg6 (bishop_f1), but bishop_f1 (amnesia) sent Be8 instead, and that move was played, costing 340 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Only the piece named in the team's agreed plan may send a move this turn; every other agent stays silent on the move channel (even to capture or to escape a threat) unless the plan's piece has failed to send after the chat has confirmed it, and the planned piece must re-read the plan in chat immediately before sending its own move.
- Before sending any move, the sending agent must quote the exact planned move from the latest chat plan, confirm its own piece and destination square match it character-for-character, and if they do not match, send nothing; any agent not named in the plan sends nothing, even when its piece is attacked or a capture is available.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending a move, the planned piece must write out the plan's move in chat (piece, from-square, destination, and check/capture symbols such as 'Qe3+') and then send exactly that move, with a different piece or destination (for example Qh5+ instead of Qe3+) treated as a mismatch that is never sent, and any non-planned agent must stay silent on the move channel even when its piece is attacked or a capture is available.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
